title: SHARDOR Electric Burr Coffee Grinder 2.0, Automatic Coffee Bean Grinder for Home Use, Adjustable Burr Mill with 16 Precise Settings for Espresso & French Press, Glossy Black
features: [ PRECISION BURR GRINDING ] - Metallic flat burr coffee grinder delivers a uniform grind size, for consistent coffee flavor every time.
[ CUSTOMIZABLE GRIND ] - Customizable grind with 16 grind-size settings, from coarse to ultra-fine. Grind coffee beans for any desired brewing method, from French press to espresso.
[ 14-CUP CAPACITY ] - The 2-14 cup selector allows you to grind only what you need, for fresh coffee grounds every time.
[ EASY TO CLEAN ] - Removable top burr, Bean Hopper, Grind Chamber, with an included cleaning brush for effortless cleaning.
[ FULLY AUTOMATIC ] - Enjoy convenient, hands-free grinding with the fully automatic electric coffee grinder that dispenses and grinds to the desired consistency.
[ CONVENIENT DESIGN ] - More compact design for ease of use and maximum counter space.
